generationPolicies.may-generate-new: A generator may create a new asset for this role (in-style, token colors); in generation mode only with generated:/user-supplied:/placeholder: refs.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Proprietary Riley IP. Only the registered files, only in mode 'clone'. Output in mode 'generation' must not reproduce or imitate it.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, real trademarks, real articles, health evidence). Never generate a substitute; only registered files, only in mode 'clone'.
generationPolicies.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: A live URL/endpoint. PageSpecs carry the role, never the URL; generated output must not embed the live Riley endpoint.

pinnedNote: generationPolicy of every real-world-weighted role AND availability of EVERY role are pinned in code (PINNED_POLICIES / PINNED_AVAILABILITY in schema/semantic_validate.py, re-pinned independently in extraction/verify_all.py). Editing this file alone cannot loosen a role.

brand-wordmark.guidance: Riley's own wordmark. Reuse the exact file only when rendering THIS Riley clone. Generated output for any other brand must not reproduce, trace, recolor or imitate it.
brand-wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

mascot-illustration.guidance: Proprietary Riley cloud characters (Riley, Worrier, Guide, Softie, Spark, Uplifter, Explorer). Reuse exact files only inside this clone; never generate new poses, and never reproduce or imitate the characters for another brand.
mascot-illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

mascot-family-mark.guidance: Parenting-style family character marks. Same policy as mascot-illustration.
mascot-family-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

mascot-avatar.guidance: Mascot-style cloud avatars (checked: purple1.svg is a lilac cloud face, NOT a photo of the reviewer). They stand in for real reviewers; never replace with a generated human face implying a real person said the quote.
mascot-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

brand-illustration.guidance: Riley's bespoke illustrations (hero scene, 404 worrier scene, feature-card art, phone shell). Reuse exact inside the clone; other brands must commission/generate their own art and must not imitate these.
brand-illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

rive-animation.guidance: Rive chat animations (byte-identical files; each slide picks artboard + state machine). Content is canvas-rendered Riley product UI and not measurable in the DOM. Reuse exact; never re-author or fabricate a chat transcript in its place.
rive-animation.generatedModeGuidance: Clone mode only (faithful reconstruction of this Riley clone). In generation mode this role is rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET; use one of generationSafeSubstitutes.

press-logo.guidance: Real third-party media trademarks (NBC, Axios, The Bump, FinSMEs, TechCrunch, Glamour). Never generate, redraw or add press logos; never reproduce these in generated output (they assert real coverage of Riley). Other brands must supply their own verified, licensed coverage logos.
press-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

advisor-portrait.guidance: Photos of real named clinicians (Dr. Lilly Jay, Dr. Kate Roche). Never fabricate a clinician portrait, name or credential; never reuse these likenesses outside this clone.
advisor-portrait.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

user-story-photo.guidance: Photos of real users paired with their chat stories. Never fabricate a user photo or story; never reuse outside this clone.
user-story-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

lifestyle-photo.guidance: Licensed photographs of real people (checked: 2.png shows a parent feeding a baby) used as FAQ portraits. Do not reproduce outside this clone; other brands must source their own licensed imagery (no AI faces passed off as customers).
lifestyle-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

blog-cover-photo.guidance: Cover photos of real Riley articles (Sanity CDN). A cover belongs to a real article; never pair it with an invented title and never reuse outside this clone.
blog-cover-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

store-badge.guidance: Apple trademarks (App Store badge, Apple glyph). Use only Apple's official artwork per Apple's marketing guidelines; never redraw or generate a store badge.
store-badge.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

decorative-cloud.guidance: Faceless decorative cloud shapes. May be generated new (soft white/gradient cloud blobs); must not include faces/eyes (that turns them into Riley mascots).
decorative-cloud.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

ui-icon.guidance: Generic UI/pictogram icons. May be generated new in the same flat purple/latte style; keep stroke/fill colors on tokens.
ui-icon.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

app-store-onelink.guidance: Live Riley AppsFlyer OneLink attribution URLs. A PageSpec never carries an href (schema has no href field); the renderer resolves this role. Generated output must not embed these live URLs for any page other than this clone.
app-store-onelink.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

newsletter-endpoint.guidance: The clone's newsletter form has NO real endpoint: submit is prevented. Generated output must not wire it to Riley's real newsletter provider or any live endpoint; leave it unwired or point it at the consuming brand's own endpoint.
newsletter-endpoint.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

internal-route.guidance: Same-site navigation. Targets must be mapped routes (templates.json routes) — pending/excluded routes are allowed as link targets only where the source already links them (blog, footer text pages).
internal-route.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

unspecified-destination.guidance: CTAs whose destination is UNVERIFIED in recon (CLONE_SPEC §0.6). The generator may choose a destination for its own brand; never assume a Riley live URL.
unspecified-destination.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

article-cover-photo.guidance: Cover photos of real Riley articles (downloaded from the original's image CDN; many show real babies and parents). A cover belongs to its real article: never pair it with another title, never generate a look-alike, never reuse outside this clone.
article-cover-photo.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

author-avatar.guidance: Photos of the real article authors and the real medical reviewer. Never fabricate an author/reviewer portrait, name or credential; never reuse these likenesses outside this clone.
author-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

social-share-mark.guidance: Facebook, Instagram and X marks. Use only the platforms' official artwork under their brand guidelines; never redraw or generate a platform mark.
social-share-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

policy-embed.guidance: Riley's third-party policy-embed ids (terms, privacy, cookies). On the original the embed is blocked by its own CSP so the legal body renders empty; the clone renders the same empty slot. Generated pages must never reference these ids or the policy vendor's endpoints for another brand: the operator supplies its own legal text.
policy-embed.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

source-citation.guidance: Article source citations (medical/health references). The clone shows placeholder citations only. Generated pages must never invent a medical citation or a study: sources are operator-supplied, or the section is omitted.
source-citation.generatedModeGuidance: Real-world-weighted (real people, children, third-party marks, live endpoints, health evidence). Allowed only in clone mode with the registered files/endpoints; in generation mode it is rejected and must be replaced by a generationSafeSubstitutes role.

placeholder-brand-mark.guidance: A neutral placeholder wordmark/logo for a fictional or operator brand (text mark or generated: shape). Never derived from the Riley wordmark.
placeholder-brand-mark.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

user-supplied-asset.guidance: Any asset the operator supplies and licenses (their own logo, store badges obtained from the store's official artwork, their own photos). Referenced as user-supplied:<id>.
user-supplied-asset.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

generated-illustration.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

placeholder-screenshot.guidance: A grey placeholder or generated mock of the operator's own product UI; never a Riley screen, chat transcript or Rive file.
placeholder-screenshot.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

fictional-person-avatar.guidance: Avatar of a clearly fictional person (generated illustration or initials). Never a photo of a real person, never a child photo, never implied to be a real customer or clinician.
fictional-person-avatar.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

placeholder-logo.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.

placeholder-url.generatedModeGuidance: Usable in generation mode, but only with a generated:, user-supplied: or placeholder: assetRef (or a placeholder href): files under /assets/ are Riley source files and are rejected by GENERATION_MODE_ASSET in generation mode.
